text: Good evening. I'm writing about my granddaughter, who is 10 and staying with me this week while her parents are working. This evening she felt hot, so I took her temperature and it was 39°C. I've had a good look at her and her colour is quite normal, skin and lips just as they usually are, so I'm not worried on that score. The other thing is her eczema. It has flared up over the last day or so, mostly in the creases of her elbows and behind her knees. The patches are very dry and she's been scratching at them. I've put her usual cream on, but it doesn't seem to be helping much. I'd like some advice on two things: what to do about the temperature tonight, and whether there's anything else I can do for the eczema until her mother can get her to the doctor. Thank you.
